Hi Sofia — thanks for the completed questionnaire, got it. Below are inline answers and clarifications (high-level); we can review in detail on the call Wednesday.

- SOC 2 coverage:
  * Our SOC 2 Type II (report available under NDA) covers our hosted control plane and the managed services we operate. For Redwood Private (VPC) deployments where the control plane is still managed by Redwood but compute runs in customer-owned VPC, the report covers the control plane controls.
  * For fully on-prem / air-gapped installations where the control plane is customer-managed, we provide an attestation package and a deployment checklist; we can coordinate an agreed-upon scope for evidence that aligns with Acme's procurement.

- HIPAA / BAA:
  * Yes — we sign a BAA for customers processing PHI. For Private/on-prem deployments we include the relevant BAA addendum and operational guidance.

- Air-gapped / on-prem updates:
  * We offer an offline installer and an onboarding runbook for air-gapped environments (checksum-signed artifacts, offline update bundles, and a documented upgrade procedure).
  * For long-term maintenance we either provide an on-site update process or a secure transfer mechanism agreed in the SOW.

- Network isolation & encryption:
  * Customer VPC option: customer-managed subnets and NACLs, no public IPs for inference nodes by default, private peering and strict egress controls.
  * KMS/HSM: customer-managed KMS keys supported (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, on-prem HSM integration).
  * KV/prefix cache: can be configured to avoid persisting sensitive data; tokenization and redaction options available per workload.

Attachments I uploaded to our secure drive and included in this thread:
- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_redacted.pdf
- redwood_private_deployment_options_v1.pdf

Related links:
- Deployment diagram templates: https://drive.google.com/redwood/private-deployment-diagram-templates
- SOC 2 summary (redacted): https://redwoodinference.sharepoint.com/SOC2/summary

If you can share a high-level network diagram for the intended deployment (subnets, NAT/gateway placement, outbound egress requirements), we will prepare a tailored runbook and a short checklist for procurement.

Confirming Wed 3/24 10:00 AM PT for the technical walkthrough — I'll include Marissa (security lead) and one of our solutions engineers.
